fact: On 17 July 2023 the Prime Minister inaugurated in Niaréla, Bamako, the Danew Talla Electronics unit assembling laptops, tablets and smartphones, built with over 550 million FCFA and already having produced nearly 4,000 devices.
title: Mali : Dr Choguel Kokalla Maïga inaugure la première usine d'assemblage des appareils électroniques
